item.title: GEF Capital Partners Raises $615 Million for India-Focused Climate Fund
item.description: Global private equity investment firm GEF Capital Partners has announced the first close of its India-focused climate fund, Fund IV, at $615 million (~₹56.8 billion).
item.dc:creator: Melvin Mathew

item.title: Solar Cell Manufacturing Capacity Under ALMM-II Grows to 49 GW
item.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has added 2,018 MW of solar cell manufacturing capacity to the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) List-II, increasing the total capacity to 49,008 MW from 46,990 MW.
item.dc:creator: Arjun Joshi

item.title: MNRE Limits ALMM-II Solar Cell Model Identification Code to 12 Characters
item.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has reduced the proposed 14-character alphanumeric code to 12 characters under the standardized nomenclature for solar cell models enlisted under the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) List-II, to improve product identification and traceability across the solar manufacturing value chain.
item.dc:creator: Melvin Mathew
